args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That saved report likely needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living.

Sofia
